text: Pradosha is the hour between day and night, and our tradition holds that what is unsettled can be set down there.
Shiva is worshipped as the one who takes what we cannot carry.
On this Masa Shivaratri, you may offer an abhishekam with water or milk, or simply light a deepam before His picture.
Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' as long as it feels natural.
Offer Bilva leaves if you have them; and know that it is no less of a puja if you do not.
